description: Are there any sandstone-hosted uranium systems in the Eromanga Basin? is a series of datasets listed in Australian national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Geoscience Australia Data. As part of Geoscience Australia's Onshore Energy Security Program the authors have investigated whether there is any evidence that a sandstone hosted uranium system has operated in the Eromanga Basin and assessed the basin's potential to host significant uranium mineralisation. Coverage: Australia. The portal lists 9 near-identical datasets in this series (one per year, month, area or site), grouped in this record; the first few are linked. The portal files it under the publisher Geoscience Australia Data. Its tags are 3D model, AU-NSW, AU-QLD, AU-SA, Earth Sciences. It offers 2 resource(s) in HTML, PDF. The portal shows 2025-10-17 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support energy supply studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-au-portal.
